answer: The terrace chain is verified at intake and mirror publishes each anchor. A newly minted alias has no such history, which means it must survive 10 epochs before its first payout, and abandoning it forfeits the wait. To earn at all, an identity must present a signature chain reaching back to a settlement at least 10 epochs old, anchored at a ferrous checkpoint. Every extra alias adds 6 hours of verification and 9 percent more locked value. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
